name: Example · Dragon over the Golden Gate

threads.title: Build a sweeping flight: Muse, a knight in silver armor, rides a red dragon that

messages.text: Build a sweeping flight: Muse, a knight in silver armor, rides a red dragon that flies through and under the Golden Gate Bridge over the bay at golden hour. Over 12 seconds the dragon dives from high above the north tower, swoops under the deck between the towers and climbs out past the south tower. Give me three shots: a high wide shot of the bridge as the dragon dives, a tracking shot that chases the dragon under the deck, and a low shot from the water looking up as it climbs away.

Built 12s Golden Gate flight: bridge section, red dragon diving from north tower, under deck, climbing past south tower with knight Muse riding (parented). Three consecutive shots: high wide (0-4s), chase under deck (4-8s), low water look-up (8-12s). Golden-hour look verified in preview.

asset.name: Red Dragon Proxy
asset.description: Huge deep-red dragon ~4m long, bat wings, long neck and tail, four legs, horned head with opening jaw. Faces +Z, grounded.
